capabilities: Chat with LLMs in any open Markdown file with streaming responses
Transcribe audio files via Whisper using WikiLinks
Load text files, PDFs, and web pages into conversations
Send images to vision-capable models via WikiLinks or web links
Configure named system prompts and personalities through frontmatter
extras: Cloud models require a paid OpenAI API account; a downloadable demo vault is provided; future plans include DALL·E image generation, ElevenLabs speech, Templater code execution, and AI-to-AI prompting.
motivation: The author frames it as giving the second brain 'a pen (let it do the writing for once), ears (talking is easier than typing) and multiple split personalities (give your system prompts names).'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with LLMs or transcribe audio inside notes, so users must leave the vault or copy text back and forth.
